$doc: Vyomi capability registry — KMS. See s3.json for the contract.

kms.key.policy.title: Key policy
limitations: The key policy document is stored and returned exactly as written, but Vyomi does not evaluate it — it never denies or allows a KMS call based on policy content.

kms.key.rotation.title: Key rotation (automatic flag + on-demand)
limitations: Automatic rotation really fires: Vyomi has no background scheduler, so EnableKeyRotation's period is checked lazily (on the next operation against the key, or the next GetKeyRotationStatus/DescribeKey/ListKeyRotations call) rather than on a running clock, exactly how DynamoDB TTL and Secrets Manager rotation are evaluated here — but the backing key material does genuinely rotate on schedule, not just get recorded. Ciphertext from before any rotation keeps decrypting, exactly like AWS.

kms.crypto.asymmetric.title: Sign / Verify, GenerateMac / VerifyMac, Encapsulate / Decapsulate
limitations: Signatures, MACs and ML-KEM shared secrets are produced with Vyomi's own authenticated primitive (the same construction as Encrypt/Decrypt), not real RSA/ECC/ML-DSA math or ML-KEM lattice math. They are genuine, tamper-detected and key-separated, but only verifiable inside Vyomi — not with a real public key outside it.

kms.custom-key-stores.title: Custom key stores (AWS CloudHSM / external key stores)
limitations: Create/describe/update/connect/disconnect/delete are real and stateful. A CloudHSM-type store connects to Vyomi's software HSM cluster (cluster-vyomisofthsm) when a KeyStorePassword was given - an unknown cluster ends FAILED CLUSTER_NOT_FOUND, a missing password INVALID_CREDENTIALS; there is no CloudHSM hardware. An external key store connects to Vyomi's built-in XKS proxy (https://xks.vyomi.local); any other proxy endpoint gets a real GET <endpoint><path>/health probe on the offline appliance (FAILED XKS_PROXY_NOT_REACHABLE when it does not answer 200) and always fails on Nano (no sockets). Connecting is immediate (no CONNECTING phase). A store that still holds keys cannot be deleted (CustomKeyStoreHasCMKsException).

kms.custom-key-store-keys.title: Keys backed by a custom key store (CloudHSM / external)
limitations: CreateKey with Origin AWS_CLOUDHSM / EXTERNAL_KEY_STORE needs a CONNECTED store of the matching type; the key's material is generated into the store's own partition (never the KMS key table) and every Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey fetches it from there, so the key is unusable (KMSInvalidStateException) while its store is disconnected and usable again on reconnect. Only SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT ENCRYPT_DECRYPT keys, no rotation (as in AWS). Keys in an external store use Vyomi's built-in XKS proxy for the crypto: pointing a store at a third-party proxy only tests its health - Vyomi does not send crypto requests to external proxies or sign XKS requests. The 'HSM' is software inside Vyomi, not CloudHSM hardware or a FIPS boundary.
